prediction.rationale: Clause 19 sets the closure window at seven working days but requires a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay. Lines 31–34 calculate the delay as elapsed calendar days minus (elapsed calendar days minus (elapsed working days minus 7)), which reduces to elapsed working days minus 7. Line 35 multiplies that working-day overrun by 500, so the penalty count conflicts with the clause's calendar-day basis.
